title: David Dunham - Totally Not a Roguelike Deckbuilder
speaker: David Dunham
description:
I originally designed Thousand Hells as a roguelike narrative card game, but a potential publisher was concerned that it looked like all the roguelike deckbuilders. It wouldn’t stand out in the market, and worse, wouldn’t satisfy players who would think they were buying a deckbuilder. My first thought was that it would be really hard to turn it into something else, but it turned out to be simpler than I’d feared.

I’ll discuss why the game was a roguelike card game in the first place, the specifics of revamping it, and the impact on the design and player experience.

The talk should especially interest designers who are concerned about making their game stand out (whether or not it’s for sale), but also cover why a roguelike had cards in the first place.
